mapper.select: SELECT d.*, (SELECT f.size_bytes FROM file_object f WHERE f.enterprise_id = d.enterprise_id AND f.id = d.file_id) AS file_size_bytes FROM knowledge_document d WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND d.resource_id = #{resource} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.file_id = #{file} OR d.active_file_id = #{file} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_chunk c WHERE c.enterprise_id = d.enterprise_id AND c.document_id = d.id AND c.file_id = #{file} AND c.generation <= d.active_generation))
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET active_file_id = file_id, active_generation = pending_generation, pending_generation = 0, status = 'ready', chunk_count = #{count}, page_count = #{pages}, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, processed_at = #{now}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND id = #{id}
